notes: Bachelor level recorded 409 programme rows read from the table in the 2027-28 International Undergraduate Admissions Bulletin (U of T Mississauga, U of T Scarborough, U of T St. George Faculty of Arts & Science, and the St. George professional faculties); the document does not state a total.

Detail shows the campus/faculty and the admission category heading the programme sits under; a programme name can repeat across campuses or categories because each is a separate admission row. Rows with a colon are streams the table lists beneath a programme (for example Computer Science streams at Scarborough, Music streams).
Left out: the Artist Diploma - Classical only line in the Faculty of Music (a diploma, not a first-entry bachelor programme). Names are kept as printed including degree labels in brackets.

Seven table cells that combined two or three adjacent programmes were split by hand by position (for example Applied Statistics / Computer Science / Mathematical Sciences at Mississauga); the three Work and Organizations contexts lines (Humanities, Sciences, Social Sciences Contexts) are indented under Work and Organizations in the table.

The Pearson pages do not say whether every programme is open to international applicants for the scholarship; any_subject is left unset because the wording is "first-entry undergraduate programs", not "any subject".
